repo.description: # API Tokens Never Expire - **Title:** Sanctum API Tokens Have No Expiration - Leaked Tokens Grant Permanent Access - **Severity:** Medium - **CVSS Score:** 6.5 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N) **Impact:** Once an API token is leaked (via logs, accidental commit, network interception), it provides permanent access with no automated revocation or expiry. **Affected File:** - `config/sanctum.php:49` **Root Cause:** ```php 'expiration' => null, ``` **Steps to Reproduce:** 1. Create an API token with root ability. 2. Use the token months later - it still works. 3.
